title: Slicing localization in U: near each x₀ ∈ U, R⌞B_r(x₀) is an integer multiplicity current supported in B̄_r(x₀) with finite mass and boundary mass, and its boundary agrees with ∂R in B_r(x₀) (Simon Ch. 6, 4.6–4.10 and 6.2 general case; supplied steps 1–3 and the first half of step 7)
statement: Assume (REP), (IMC)(b), (IMC)(d) and (SL); they appear verbatim, in this order, as the hypotheses of the Lean statement. (REP) is the first conjunct of the frozen type of the sibling foundations node (closure-a1.foundations-a1), i.e. the frozen type of cmc_exists_massRepresentation; (IMC)(b) and (IMC)(d) are the second and fourth conjuncts of the parent hypothesis (IMC) (type of the accepted cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub); (SL) is the frozen type of the accepted sibling slicing (cmc_slice_mass_bounds). In words: (REP) every X ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U ⊆ ℝ^P open, with M_W(X) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U has a Borel measure μ (finite on compact subsets of U, μ(G) = M_G(X) for open G, μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0) and a μ-a.e. strongly measurable field ξ of n-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α and X(ω) = ∫ ξ(ω) dμ for ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (plus an Hⁿ-null-set clause not used here); (IMC)(b) for an IMRep (M, θ, ξ) in an open U and a Borel set E there are a current A and an IMRep in U representing A with carrier M ∩ E, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ; (IMC)(d) every IMRep (M, θ, ξ) satisfies |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every α; (SL) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), U open, represented by (μ, ξ) with ∂X represented by (μ', ξ') (measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable fields with |·| ≤ 1 a.e.) and an L-Lipschitz f, there are A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω) dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η) dμ', ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η misses {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) and ∫⁻_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t) dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for open W. Let P, d ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, R ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) integer multiplicity with M_W(∂R) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and x₀ ∈ U. Then there are r > 0 with closedBall(x₀, r) ⊆ U and an integer multiplicity R' ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) (in the proof R' = R⌞B_r(x₀)) with spt R' ⊆ closedBall(x₀, r), M(R') < ∞ and M(∂R') < ∞ (M = mass in U), such that ∂R'(η) = ∂R(η) for every η ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport η ⊆ B_r(x₀). Notation: SimonGMT currents, M_W = massOn W, spt = GeometricCurrentOn.support, |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α, W ⊂⊂ U = CompactlyContained W U, IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity.
